name: humm-speech-to-code
description: Speak code logic. Get clean, formatted code. No typing.
author: HUMM

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c teal,yellow "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -n api,web,desk -c teal,yellow,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && electron . --dev"
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis portable --x64
